changelog: **The site knows it is inside the native app** (#2775). The app's web view sends `InternCRMApp/1` in its User-Agent; the root layout then renders `<html data-embedded-app>` (`src/lib/embeddedApp.ts` — server-rendered because a script-set attribute was stripped by React's hydration of `<html>`), and anything marked `data-app-chrome` (ResponsiveShell's mobile top bar and drawer, MessagesShell's header, the install prompt) is hidden there by one rule in `globals.css`; browsers are unchanged. New `GET /api/app/navigation` returns the role's web sidebar (`appNavLinks()` over `navLinks.ts`, same capability filter and sales-surface choice as the layouts, labels from `t.nav`) for the app's native menu. App: the page reports its title and colours, so the native header shows the page's own name on the page's own background (no empty white bar over a dark page); native screens follow the phone's light/dark setting with the web's grays; the More tab is the native menu plus account actions. Pinned by `e2e/mobile-app-shell.spec.ts`, `scripts/test/app-navigation.test.mjs` and the app's unit tests (including one that fails when a nav key has no icon).
